description: This Java source file contains the definition of the class 'ThingModifiedEventAssert', which provides custom assertion methods for testing instances of 'ThingModifiedEvent' in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to verify event properties such as type, thing ID, headers, revision, entity data, and resource path.
